mentions.name: caducode
mentions.description: A toy coding agent built as a thought experiment that gives the LLM a single tool, run_python(), instead of a bunch of separate tools; the agent generates Python code to inspect local files, carry out edits, and run commands. It reportedly works surprisingly well even with a small 30b local model.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've created a toy coding agent called "caducode". More of a thought experiment that materialized into a little something.

The philosophy behind it is: instead of providing a bunch of tools to the LLM, you simply provide a single tool: run_python(). The Agent just generates code to do whatever it needs, to inspect local files, to carry edits, to run commands.
